mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% triggers a labor market tightening effect, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rates and concurrent fall in unemployment rates signals conflicting policy signals, yet their combined effect during a tightening labor market and rate hike cycle drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening labor market and rate hike cycle
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite both FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by rising GDP (GDPC1) and demand indicators (HOUST), sustained growth signals peak corporate profits and investor optimism, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p < 0.05) in late-cycle expansion regimes despite high GDPC1 and HOUST values.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months reflects robust supply-side growth, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite sustained monthly increases in INDPRO over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 95 in a given month, it signals a surge in supply chain activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive when INDPRO crosses above 95 in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and concurrent fall in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, which enhances corporate productivity and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite both PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: During an expanding economy regime marked by rising GDP (GDPC1) and demand indicators (HOUST), sustained growth in corporate profits and consumer spending fuels equity market optimism, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p < 0.05) in expanding economy regimes despite high GDPC1 and HOUST values.
